changelog.text: Solved the CIE-I 2026 (12-10-2026) Unit 2 questions: Q3a 4:1 MUX realisation of Σm(1,3,4,6,10,12,13,14), Q3b analysis of the given MUX (F = A′B + BC′ + AB′C), Q4b three-sensor 3:8 decoder (Y0 = D1+D2+D4, Y1 = D3+D5+D6, Y2 = D7), with two new figures; Q4a (4-bit CLA) linked in the question bank.

Unit 1 aligned to Dr K.B. Ramesh's Computer Arithmetic notes: teacher's trace layouts and worked examples (unsigned multiplication, Booth, restoring division), overflow rule, sign extension, IEEE 754 double precision, Radix-4 Modified Booth naming, and all five Unit-1 questions from CIE-I 2026 solved.

Shift registers (§7.1) aligned to the 2026 faculty notes: Q3–Q0 / P3–P0 notation, Load/Shift 0 = shift, applications, shift-left SISO, circular SR, USR operation + worked example, and the CIE-II 2024/2025 register designs (§7.2.1).
Light/dark toggle moved to the top-right so it no longer covers the Suggest / report button.
Added ▶ Videos buttons: 104 hand-checked short videos from Neso Academy, ALL ABOUT ELECTRONICS and Gate Smashers, with a note where a video differs from the notes.
First ADLD release: Unit 1, Unit 2 (combinational + sequential halves in one guide) and Unit 3, aligned to the new syllabus.
